comments: Listed as part of rNgog Blo ldan shes rab's compositions by several Tibetan scholars (see <<Kano 2016 [BAQ9MH4T]>>: 204). It would correspond to the "spyod 'jug Tik+ka" listed by A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 514, No. 11077: rngog blo ldan shes rab kyi spyod 'jug Tik+ka).
name: byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i rnam bshad
